Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production 16:9 full-bleed landscape background for Frontier Fortune, an original spaghetti western slot game.
Scene/backdrop: a deserted dusty American frontier town at burnt-orange dusk, a crimson sun setting behind distant mesas and telegraph poles. Weathered timber saloon and sheriff-office facades frame only the far left and right edges, amber windows and a few shaded lamps; no readable signage.
Composition/framing: wide cinematic landscape, 2048x1152 preferred. Keep the central 55 percent quiet, dark, spacious and low-detail for a large slot cabinet overlay, with nothing salient competing behind the reels. Layered depth, horizon in upper third, dark foreground dusty street and subtle drifting dust, no foreground characters.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted cinematic concept art, authentic Italian spaghetti western film-poster atmosphere, tactile brushwork, worn film grain and weathered materials, dramatic silhouettes; sophisticated rather than cartoon.
Color palette: tobacco brown, burnt ochre, oxblood red, dusty teal shadows, restrained warm amber-gold light.
Lighting/mood: tense, sun-baked, lonely frontier at golden dusk; dark vignette around outer lower corners.
Constraints: environment only. No symbols, no slot cabinet, no game UI, no border or frame, no logos, no text or watermark, no foreground people, no horses, no modern elements. Fill entire image.
